issues.description: Interface name mismatch for the ride/rideable concept: the problem statement (problem_statement.md) and the template Main.java refer to an interface named 'Rideable' with an abstract method messageOnRide(), but the solution repository defines an interface named 'Mountable' that declares messageOnRide() and leaves Rideable.java empty. Concrete classes in the solution (Pig.java, Seal.java) implement Mountable, while the exercise text and template refer to Rideable. This naming divergence (Rideable vs Mountable) will confuse students about which interface to implement and may break or misalign tests and example usage that expect 'Rideable'.
issues.suggestedFix:
Unify the interface name across all artifacts. Preferred fixes (choose one to preserve pedagogical intent):
1) Rename the solution's Mountable interface to Rideable, move or copy the method signature String messageOnRide() into Rideable.java, and update Pig.java and Seal.java to implement Rideable (remove the empty Rideable.java). OR
2) Update the problem statement and template to use the name Mountable instead of Rideable (and document the expected method signature messageOnRide()).
Ensure the final single interface name appears consistently in the problem statement, template code comments/usage, and solution files so students know which interface to implement.
